version: Mira model roster v10 - keeps M01-M05 active and adds M06-M09 reserve identities
public_rule: Do not publish model names or model IDs. Active profiles and reserve identities are internal production controls for consistent outfit imagery across age cohorts.
assignment_rule: M01, M02, M03, M04, and M05 are the five active fixed internal model identities and remain the only weekly rotation. M06 is a face-only reserve without an approved full-body anchor. M07, M08, and M09 each retain a face/full-body reserve pair. M09 also requires age calibration. M06, M07, M08, and M09 must not enter production unless the user explicitly activates them after all required anchors and metadata are approved. Active identities are not tied to fixed outfit occasions; any weekly trend can be styled for work, weekend, date, travel, rainy day, or casual use with any active model when the content plan calls for it.
age_prompt_policy: True ages are roster metadata only. Image prompts may use prompt_age_language, never numeric true_age. Preserve recognizable adult identity, believable skin texture and normal human variation without age caricature, smoothing instructions or beauty retouching.
